pool_initialized_at_tick_zero.meaning: pool is initialized at tick 0 with liquidity

victim_swap_sqrt_ratio_limit_near_price.meaning: victim submits a swap with sqrtRatioLimit set near the current price for slippage protection

victim_eth_sent_wei.meaning: native ETH sent by the victim via msg.value (10 ether)

eth_sent_to_core.meaning: ETH has been sent to Core via msg.value
eth_sent_to_core.checkpoint: after ETH is sent to Core

eth_recovery_mechanism_exists.meaning: a mechanism exists to account for or recover ETH sent to Core
eth_recovery_mechanism_exists.checkpoint: after ETH is sent to Core

eth_stuck_forever.meaning: ETH sent to Core is stuck forever
eth_stuck_forever.checkpoint: after ETH is sent to Core

assumptions: ETH sent to Core is the native ETH forwarded via msg.value by the victim swap.

unresolved.description: The intent requires a recovery/accounting mechanism for ETH sent to Core, but the report does not define the observable condition under which ETH is considered recoverable versus permanently stuck; the required_effect condition uses a bool placeholder for ETH being sent.

limitations: The exact sqrtRatioLimit numeric value and the no-op comparison operands are not fully specified in the report; the near-price qualifier is encoded as a grounded Boolean.
Whether the victim's 10 ETH is sent before or after the no-op check within the same transaction is not separately evidenced; the ETH-sent checkpoint is treated as the swap submission.
